_comment: Inputs for build_panoramas.py. `discovery` queries the NASA Images API for 360-degree Photojournal entries; `curated` adds or overrides entries with values verified against the official caption (sol range, stated orientation, and for rovers without a pose table an explicit, cited position); `exclude` lists entries deliberately left out and why. Positions otherwise come from shared/poses/<site>_poses.csv; captions, credits and image files from each PIA's Photojournal page.

curated.note: Everest panorama from the summit of Husband Hill; caption: sols 620 to 622
McMurdo panorama from Low Ridge; caption: sol 814 to sol 980
'Lion King' panorama of Eagle Crater, sols 58 and 60, taken from the crater rim just after the rover left it

position.source: Opportunity landing site in Eagle Crater (PDS MER mission description, MOLA IAU 2000); the rover was on the crater rim, within about 20 m

exclude.reason: Opportunity at Greeley Haven (sols 2811-2947): the only published traverse (MERB_traverse_5130.csv) does not state its coordinate frame, so the stop cannot be placed without assuming one
